propositions: Dependabot PR #131 contains updates to five packages (botocore, genai-prices, json-repair, mypy, ruff) and must be re-authored as a Gerrit change to land, since GitHub is read-only and all changes flow through Gerrit.

The PR's pinned versions were superseded by further upstream releases; the current resolver provides botocore 1.43.75, genai-prices 0.1.4, json-repair 0.63.3, mypy 2.3.1, ruff 0.16.3, which were used instead of the PR's stated pins to avoid fighting dependabot.
Lint and typecheck gates (make lint and make typecheck) pass under ruff 0.16.3 and mypy 2.3.1 with no new findings, no suppressions added, and no code changes required.
The complexity ratchet check passes with active=49, new=0, increased=0, stale=0, confirming ruff 0.16.3 scores unchanged from 0.16.2 and .github/complexity-baseline.json remains unmodified.

The change landed to Gerrit as change 1943 with merged sha dab851c5fb53db4e2cd63e49a305997e4db48f3b, carrying LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1, with the full CI matrix passing across all Python versions and test suites.
